The '''Poseidenna system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]], within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It lay at the terminus of a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] branching off from the [[Minntooine system/Legends|Minntooine system]], where the [[Giblim Route]] and [[Minntooine Spur]] converged.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Poseidenna system was created for ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square U-7.<ref name="Atlas" /> In keeping with [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Realspace/Legends|Space's]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] theme,<ref name="Oceanic">[[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]] is home to a particular concentration of [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworlds]], including [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]] (''[[The Essential Atlas]]''); [[Minntooine/Legends|Minntooine]] ({{CSWECite|II|317|Minntooine}}); [[Sanctuary/Legends|Sanctuary]] ([[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]); and [[Krinemonen III]] (''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''); as well as the thematically-named [[Tidal Circuit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] (''The Essential Atlas'').</ref> the Poseidenna system derives its name from<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Wikipedia:Poseidon|Poseidon]], the god of the sea in [[Wikipedia:Greek mythology|Greek mythology]].<ref name="Britannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/topic/Poseidon|text=Poseidon|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=2018-01-03|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica Online|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20180201050103}}</ref>
